---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement or new capability for Aviary
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

Describe the feature or improvement you want to see.

## Problem Statement

What user or operator problem does this solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the preferred solution. Include affected services or packages when relevant.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe other approaches you considered and why they are less suitable.

## Additional Context

Include mockups, API sketches, operational constraints, or prior discussion links if relevant.

## Impact

- Who benefits from this change?
- Does this affect API contracts, schema, authentication, security, or deployment workflows?
- Are there backward-compatibility concerns?

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate.
- [ ] I explained the problem, not just the desired output.
- [ ] I called out compatibility, security, or migration concerns where relevant.
- [ ] I agree to follow Aviary's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/robertherbaugh/aviary/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
